newsitem.title: USA: Chemed owns 97 percent of Roto-Rooter.
newsitem.headline: Chemed owns 97 percent of Roto-Rooter.

text.p: Chemed Corp., a diversified corporation, said Thursday it now owns 97 percent of Roto-Rooter Inc.'s outstanding common stock, after the completion of a tender offer for the shares.
Roto-Rooter, based in Cincinnati, is the largest provider of sewer and drain cleaning services in the United States.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Chemed said its $41 per share tender offer expired on Sept. 11 with about 2.1 million common shares tendered.
Cincinnati-based Chemed launched the tender offer in early August for the roughly 42 percent of Roto-Rooter stock that it did not already own.

Chemed has businesses in medical and dental supply manufacturing, home healthcare services and hospice care; plumbing, drain cleaning and appliance and air-conditioning repair and maintenance; and sanitary maintenance products and services.
Roto-Rooter's stock fell 93.75 cents to $40.25 on Nasdaq at midday. Chemed rose 50 cents to $38.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
